Definition: from the same as G5514; greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored:--green, pale.
BiblicalUsage: Chloros is green, the colour of fresh growth, and in Revelation it turns pale with death. The crowds sit on the green grass to be fed, the pale horse rides out with Death on its back, the hail burns up all green grass, and the locusts are told to hurt not the grass of the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same green can mean life in the feeding of the five thousand and judgment in the trumpets, and the difference is God's hand in it. I hold that the grass of the field is in His keeping either way, and He spares what He chooses.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand
